tolerance.note: numbers relative 1e-6 (expected given to 7 s.f.); booleans exact; null = quantity undefined (e.g. half-life when k=0); errors compared exactly as {error: schema class, reason: lower_snake_case code} (KAT_SCHEMA 17:46)

convention: Units are whatever the user supplies, consistently (rate constants per time unit of t). decay: order 0/1/2 integrated rate laws, C clamped at 0 for zero order with depleted=true once t>=C0/k; half_life null when k=0. radioactive: lambda=ln2/T1/2, activity=lambda N. reactor: isothermal, constant density, liquid phase; Da=k tau C0^(order-1); CSTR X from the steady design equation, PFR from the integrated plug-flow equation; orders 1 and 2 only (scope cap). lake: completely mixed, first-order loss, steady C=W/(Q+kV), response time V/(Q+kV). tank_step: first-order lag y=K du (1-e^(-t/tau)) from rest. growth: exponential N0 e^(rt); logistic closed form. monod: mu=mu_max S/(Ks+S), doubling time ln2/mu. lv_*: dx/dt=alpha x-beta x y, dy/dt=delta x y-gamma y (x prey, y predator); lv_state uses fixed-step RK4 with the given h and must agree with the high-accuracy reference to 1e-6. stock_flow: dS/dt=inflow-kS. Max 3 state variables and 2 reactions (scope cap). Arrhenius k(T) and Arrhenius fits are covered by mse_property_plots.json and are not repeated. MathError for division by zero / undefined; NotSupported outside the scope cap.
oracle: script-verified (textbook formulae); ChatGPT Chat cross-check pending. Closed-form expected values from P. Atkins & J. de Paula, Physical Chemistry (textbook); H. S. Fogler, Elements of Chemical Reaction Engineering (textbook); O. Levenspiel, Chemical Reaction Engineering (textbook); D. E. Seborg et al., Process Dynamics and Control (textbook); J. D. Murray, Mathematical Biology (textbook); K. S. Krane, Introductory Nuclear Physics (textbook); S. C. Chapra, Surface Water-Quality Modeling (textbook); J. D. Sterman, Business Dynamics (textbook); M. L. Shuler & F. Kargi, Bioprocess Engineering (textbook); recomputed independently by numerical ODE integration (scipy solve_ivp DOP853, rtol 1e-12), brentq root-finding of steady-state balances and Jacobian eigenvalues
